summary: Verifier, 2026-11-07. The 7.4 score stands, so the row closes at 7.4 under ruling 23. There is no blocker. Monster and Wick GLBs have not changed since 46d3c19a4. I checked the reviewer's fresh shots and reports myself: the probe metric definitions, the content heights, and a GLB clip parse of my own. NEU-1 (Sunsplinter presence), NEU-2 (flat camp size ladder) and NEU-3 (naturalistic Glasshorn) are confirmed by eye and by the numbers. NEU-2 needs one correction: the 1,493 px Glasshorn figure is the 2 px-eroded interior count (value_probe.mjs:554 Me = erode(M,2); px = own.n). Its full mask is 7,202 px in a 150 x 194 px box, against 13,702 for Resinback and 103,888 for Longshade. Glasshorn is still no bigger than a fighter, so the major stands. NEU-4 is refuted. The reviewer read hips local Y, which is world-forward because the rig root is rotated +90 deg about X. The real hips drop in world Y over the death clip is resinback 0.98->0.54 m, glasshorn 1.10->0.28, stilltusk 0.82->0.31, stilltusk_young 0.55->0.26, gloamoth 1.12->0.22 and gloamoth_little 0.55->0.11. That is 45-80 % of hip height, already inside the reviewer's own fix range. Wicks show one central hood light and no mouth on both teams. The Greatwick lantern shows one pane per face. Hoods are rounded domes. Frame timing was not measured: load was 9.05 at the start of verification.

gapStatus.evidence: content/units.json gives shieldwick, glimwick, greatwick and brightwick art.teamModels _aubade/_serenade pairs. closing_neutral2_lane.json: wicks top25 61, p95 67, lumaP95 159; fighters top25 80.4, lumaP95 208. Crops _harness/_shots/closing_neutral2_wicks_aubade_2x.png (slate and azure, lantern poles) and closing_neutral2_wicks_serenade_2x.png (umber and marigold domes, round shields) show two distinct team reads. The tester split test was not run.
art/renders/units/three_clips_greatwick_aubade.png shows one oval pane per lantern face in every clip. In-lane crops show one central light per hood and no mouth.

_harness/_reports/closing_neutral2_mon.json: the cross-camp maxima at camp facing are glasshorn|resinback 0.36 and longshade|resinback 0.46. The pairs over 0.5 (gloamoth|gloamoth_little 0.75-0.80, stilltusk|stilltusk_young 0.84, stray_numeral|stray_tick 0.57-0.58) are same-camp pairs, not cross-camp. The ruling 24 gate holds.
Content keys only. This belongs to the audio reviewer.

findings.title: Sunsplinter lacks epic presence
findings.what: Sunsplinter is an orb with a sparse ring of shards and a single pillar in a large, empty water pit. Its eroded mass is 13,771 px (full mask 29,347) against Longshade's 42,505 (103,888).
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/value_rift_high_closing_neutral2_m370_mon_sunsplinter.png (eye check: the pit is plain water with no objective dressing); _harness/_reports/closing_neutral2_mon.json m370 sunsplinter px 13771 unitPx 29347 against m1000 longshade px 42505 unitPx 103888. content/units.json lines 388-428: lib_burst_lumen, lib_ring_pulse and lib_cone_sweep.
findings.fix: As the reviewer proposed: a solid dial-glass core mass, breathing shard orbits, a noon-light pit decal and its own u_sunsplinter VFX. Gate: full-mask unitPx at least 50 % of Longshade's on RIFT High.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced by eye and in the report. Gauge check: LoL epic monsters dominate their pits, which is accurate as a gauge. I would put the gate on unitPx (full mask), not the eroded px.

findings.title: Big/buff camps no bigger than a fighter
findings.what: Glasshorn (2.2 m, the buff camp per WORLD.md:125) and Resinback (1.8 m) are 90-gold camps, yet neither is taller than fighters at 1.72-2.48 m. The reward tier does not show in size.
findings.evidence: content/units.json art.height: glasshorn 2.2, resinback 1.8, stilltusk 1.4, stray_numeral 2.4. content/fighters/*.json heights 1.72-2.48. closing_neutral2_mon.json m70: glasshorn unitPx 7202, box 150x194 px at 82.1 px/m; resinback unitPx 13702. Shots _m70_mon_glasshorn.png and _m70_mon_resinback.png. Correction: the reviewer's 1,493 px 'about one Wick' is the 2 px-eroded count (_harness/value_probe.mjs:554,585), which understates a slim deer. The conclusion holds anyway.
findings.fix: Size ladder: big and buff camps at about 1.5-1.8x fighter mass, then re-run the camp-facing IoU and dL* checks.
findings.verifierNote: Real, and the severity is right. The camp floor glyph decals help a camp read as a camp, but they do not convey the reward tier.

findings.title: Glasshorn (and less so Stilltusk) read as plain wildlife
findings.what: Glasshorn reads at the game camera as a realistic spotted fawn. Only its white antlers mark it as VALE. Stilltusk is more stylised, with a stripe pattern and a ridge of spikes, but its proportions are still natural.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/value_rift_high_closing_neutral2_m70_mon_glasshorn.png and _m70_mon_stilltusk.png; art/renders/units/glasshorn.png. WORLD.md:125/127 specifies 'a stag with glass antlers' and 'still-tusked boars', so the species is by design, but nothing in the docs justifies the realism level.
findings.fix: Push the stylisation within the WORLD.md concept: a dominant glass hour-faceted antler crown, a heavier forequarter, and dial-tick markings. For Stilltusk, exaggerate the head and shoulders.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed mainly for Glasshorn. As the buff camp, its plain look matters more. Stilltusk alone would be minor.

findings.title: Camp deaths barely drop the body
findings.what: The claim was a root drop of 0.02-0.05 m.
findings.evidence: My parse of art/out/units/*.glb death clips. The rig root node rotation is [0.707,0,0,0.707] (+90 deg X), so hips local Z maps to world height. The hips height falls resinback 0.98->0.54, glasshorn 1.10->0.28, stilltusk 0.82->0.31, stilltusk_young 0.55->0.26, gloamoth 1.12->0.22 and gloamoth_little 0.55->0.11 m. The reviewer's 0.02-0.05 m is the hips local Y channel, which is world-forward.
findings.fix: None required. Optional polish: add a hit-pause and a settle bounce.
findings.verifierNote: Measurement error (wrong axis). The drops are 45-80 % of hip height, inside the reviewer's own target. The Resinback sheet row reads as a slumping crouch from above, which is acceptable. A sideways topple was not verified because rotation accessors did not decode as float in my quick parse.

findings.title: Stray Numeral and Stray Tick idles nearly static
findings.what: The idles animate few channels: Numeral 3, Tick 2. Each has a small translation bob of 0.05-0.07 m.
findings.evidence: GLB parse: stray_numeral idle 3 channels, stray_tick idle 2 channels. closing_neutral2_mon.json m370 stray_numeral chroma 5.4 against floor 9.1, dE 21.5.
